datasets.description: UNOSAT code EQ20231104NPL, GDACS Id: 1398938 This application provides geospatial information on ongoing satellite based-assessment related with the 5.7 magnitude earthquakes in Nepal of the 03rd of November 2023. datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts reviewed and compared satellite imagery acquired before and after the 3 November 2023 earthquake to identify notable changes and assess population exposure in the affected area. The resulting dataset quantifies exposed population through spatial analysis of satellite-derived observations.

sources.name: UN Operational Satellite Applications Programme (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis and change detection methodology to assess population exposure and earthquake impacts in the Jajarkot district
